ch1_l1.title: The Dispatch Office
ch1_l1.subtitle: Harbour approach · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH
ch1_l1.intro: Search the clutter for seventeen clues. A word may describe an object, a symbol or a pattern. Some have more than one valid match.
ch1_l1.reward_text: Identify the parcel and connect Mara to the boarding-house records.

items.name: Plume
items.found_note: · a feather can also be called a plume

items.name: Timepiece
items.found_note: · a watch or clock tells the time

items.name: Club
items.found_note: · a club can be a card-suit symbol

ch1_l2.title: Tide Office
ch1_l2.intro: Tide tables cover the walls. Two clocks tick at slightly different speeds, neither quite admitting it.

items.name: Anchor
items.found_note: — a wall hook shaped like a ship’s anchor

items.name: Plume
items.found_note: — a feather tucked between the books

items.name: Fish
items.found_note: — a carved toggle among the ropes

items.name: Arrow
items.found_note: — the weather vane beyond the window

items.name: Seal
items.found_note: — a wax impression on the document

ch1_l2.reward_title: Original tide-table strip and shutter mark
ch1_l2.reward_text: Establish the first contradiction in the official flood account.
ch1_l2.subtitle: Harbour approach · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch1_l3.title: Archive Vestibule
ch1_l3.intro: The archive smells of wet wool and paper. One shelf label has been replaced more recently than its neighbours.

items.name: Goblet
items.found_note: — a stemmed cup on the book clasp

ch1_l3.reward_title: Displaced catalogue ticket and conservation supplies
ch1_l3.reward_text: Locate the removed folio and gain access to its damaged fragments.
ch1_l3.subtitle: Archive · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch1_l4.title: Restoration Room
ch1_l4.intro: A sheet of blue paper waits beneath glass weights. Lamplight turns its tears into bright little rivers.

items.name: Butterfly
items.found_note: — drawn on an old specimen card

items.name: Pear
items.found_note: — a pear carved in the tool handle

ch1_l4.reward_text: Reconstruct Mara's sequence of actions and her interest in the works.
ch1_l4.subtitle: Archive · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch1_l5.title: Boarding House
ch1_l5.intro: A narrow parlour overlooks the back of the archive. Someone has kept Mara’s supper warm twice.
ch1_l5.reward_title: Timed visitor entry and borrowed-key record
ch1_l5.reward_text: Establish her deliberate itinerary and access to the bell tower.
ch1_l5.subtitle: Bell quarter · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch1_l6.title: Bell Tower
ch1_l6.intro: The great harbour bell hangs above a much smaller practice bell. Only the smaller one has a missing pull.

items.name: Knight
items.found_note: — a chess piece in the toolbox

ch1_l6.reward_text: Restore the small signal mechanism and interpret the route she left.
ch1_l6.subtitle: Bell quarter · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch2_l1.title: Pump Court
ch2_l1.intro: Water drums beneath iron grates. Pale mineral lines remain on the sheltered walls long after the flood.

items.name: Dragonfly
items.found_note: — an iron silhouette in the gate

ch2_l1.reward_text: Select the route through the damaged works and identify the relevant channel.
ch2_l1.subtitle: Water intake · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch2_l2.title: Sluice Gallery
ch2_l2.intro: Three enormous wheels vanish into the dark. A small training board shows their interlocks in miniature.

items.name: Leaf
items.found_note: — the handle of the interlock model

ch2_l2.reward_title: Worn valve tag and inspection mark
ch2_l2.subtitle: Water intake · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch2_l3.title: Machine Room
ch2_l3.intro: The room is warm with the smell of old oil. A pressure recorder has preserved one fragile roll.

items.name: Spanner
items.found_note: — a tool silhouette on the tin

ch2_l3.reward_text: Restore a test mechanism and distinguish the bypass flow.
ch2_l3.subtitle: Engine block · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch2_l4.title: Workers’ Kitchen
ch2_l4.intro: A long table still bears the initials of workers whose shifts ended before the city remembered them.
ch2_l4.reward_text: Put the workers' movements into the correct order.
ch2_l4.subtitle: Engine block · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch2_l5.title: Lockkeeper’s Cabin
ch2_l5.intro: Tools are wrapped in linen, carefully enough to suggest grief rather than order.
ch2_l5.reward_title: Preserved tool roll and closure order
ch2_l5.reward_text: Test Rowan's account against the physical work performed.
ch2_l5.subtitle: Lockkeeper’s reach · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch2_l6.title: Spillway Overlook
ch2_l6.intro: The city’s roofs sit below the reservoir lip. From here the flood has a shape that no written excuse can alter.
ch2_l6.reward_text: Compare both water routes and identify the independent time reference.
ch2_l6.subtitle: Lockkeeper’s reach · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch3_l1.title: Observatory Steps
ch3_l1.intro: An armillary sphere gathers rain above the city. Ada’s boots have worn a dry crescent under the porch.

items.name: Saturn
items.found_note: — a ringed planet on the clasp

ch3_l1.subtitle: Observatory entrance · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch3_l2.title: Transit Hall
ch3_l2.intro: A telescope points through a slit of pale sky. On the desk, four exposure envelopes lie out of sequence.
ch3_l2.reward_text: Convert local readings into a common time.
ch3_l2.subtitle: Observatory entrance · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch3_l3.title: Plate Darkroom
ch3_l3.intro: Trays are dry now, but the room retains a mineral smell. Four glass plates wait behind red curtains.

items.name: Dragonfly
items.found_note: — a silhouette on a glass plate

ch3_l3.reward_text: Establish the independent sequence of events.
ch3_l3.subtitle: Evidence rooms · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch3_l4.title: Signal Loft
ch3_l4.intro: Coloured panes hang over a small lamp. The city below looks like a constellation someone has tried to rearrange.

items.name: Diamond
items.found_note: — a piece of red signal glass

items.name: Knight
items.found_note: — a chess knight forms the tool handle

ch3_l4.subtitle: Signal route · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch3_l5.title: Clock Workshop
ch3_l5.intro: The room is crowded with clocks that disagree for honest mechanical reasons. Ada has labelled every disagreement.
ch3_l5.reward_text: Restore the reference mechanism and verify its correction.
ch3_l5.subtitle: Evidence rooms · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch3_l6.title: Meridian Roof
ch3_l6.intro: The meridian line runs beneath your feet in brass. Far across the marsh, one window catches the light.

items.name: Triangle
items.found_note: — a set square beside the meridian line

ch3_l6.reward_text: Align the signal and locate the next destination.
ch3_l6.subtitle: Signal route · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch4_l1.title: Reed Jetty
ch4_l1.intro: The jetty rises on uneven piles. A rust-coloured cloth marks the route post; its written tag matters more than its colour.

items.name: Crescent
items.found_note: — a moon on the lantern hood

ch4_l1.reward_text: Plot a safe path and connect an unrecorded passenger journey.
ch4_l1.subtitle: Marsh crossing · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch4_l3.title: Glasshouse
ch4_l3.intro: Salt has clouded the panes. Tough little plants survive in labelled pots, each carrying a piece of the clinic’s old routine.
ch4_l3.reward_title: Label key and preserved record packet
ch4_l3.reward_text: Decode the settlement records and corroborate the register.
ch4_l3.subtitle: Old settlement · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch4_l2.title: Abandoned Clinic
ch4_l2.intro: The clinic is no longer staffed, but its cupboards have been cleaned. Someone has been working here by lamplight.
ch4_l2.reward_text: Identify who was still present when the flood arrived.
ch4_l2.subtitle: Old settlement · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch4_l4.title: Survey Hut
ch4_l4.intro: Old survey stakes lean against the wall. A map marks ground that stays high even when the paths disappear.
ch4_l4.reward_text: Reconcile the present paths with the old settlement.
ch4_l4.subtitle: Marsh crossing · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch4_l5.title: Memorial Garden
ch4_l5.intro: Names were scratched on loose stones before the council built its official monument. Some stones have only a house mark.
ch4_l5.reward_text: Restore identities omitted from the official count.
ch4_l5.subtitle: Refuge shore · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch4_l6.title: Island Refuge
ch4_l6.intro: A small house stands above the reed line. Mara opens the door holding a kettle as if you were only late for tea.
ch4_l6.reward_title: Mara's original tracing and witness lead
ch4_l6.reward_text: Compare her evidence with the route, names and chronology already recovered.
ch4_l6.subtitle: Refuge shore · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch5_l1.title: Civic Square
ch5_l1.intro: Fresh notices cover older notices. The paper is cheap enough that yesterday’s promises show through.
ch5_l1.reward_text: Find a lawful route to preserve the threatened evidence.
ch5_l1.subtitle: Public offices · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch5_l2.title: Council Chamber
ch5_l2.intro: The chamber’s high windows illuminate the public benches less generously than the magistrate’s desk.

items.name: Heart
items.found_note: — a heart cut into the clasp

ch5_l2.reward_text: Establish the authority behind the diversion.
ch5_l2.subtitle: Public offices · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch5_l3.title: Deed Vault
ch5_l3.intro: The vault shelves are orderly. Their order makes the missing moral step easier, not harder, to see.

items.name: Diamond
items.found_note: — a motif on the brass hinge

ch5_l3.reward_text: Link the affected district to a beneficiary.
ch5_l3.subtitle: Money trail · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch5_l4.title: Print Shop
ch5_l4.intro: Sera’s press takes up most of the room. There is still space on the wall for her mother’s first tenants’ notice.
ch5_l4.reward_text: Produce an accurate independent copy and verify alterations.
ch5_l4.subtitle: Publication route · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch5_l5.title: Counting Room
ch5_l5.intro: The accounts are written in a steady hand. In the margin, three sums refuse to agree with their heading.

items.name: Club
items.found_note: — a playing-card pip on the receipt

ch5_l5.reward_text: Reconcile the transaction with the signed decision.
ch5_l5.subtitle: Money trail · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch5_l6.title: Dispatch Station
ch5_l6.intro: Pneumatic tubes converge above a counter scarred by parcel weights. A clerk has kept the receipts everyone else discarded.
ch5_l6.reward_text: Preserve provenance and send the evidence through separate hands.
ch5_l6.subtitle: Publication route · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch6_l1.title: Dawn Quay
ch6_l1.intro: For the first time since your arrival, the rain has stopped. Three packets wait on a dry crate.
ch6_l1.reward_text: Arrange separate routes for people and records.
ch6_l1.subtitle: Witness passage · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch6_l2.title: Witness Room
ch6_l2.intro: The witnesses sit around an ordinary table. Nobody has been given a script for what they did not see.
ch6_l2.reward_text: Corroborate testimony and order the public account.
ch6_l2.subtitle: Witness passage · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch6_l3.title: Relay House
ch6_l3.intro: A small transmitter sends the public notice to the outer wards. Its mechanism is simpler than its reputation.

items.name: Lightning
items.found_note: — a lightning bolt on the plate

items.name: Spade
items.found_note: — a playing-card pip on the code sheet

ch6_l3.subtitle: Protected route · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch6_l4.title: Gate Crown
ch6_l4.intro: The bypass control stands above the city. In daylight it looks less like fate and more like a lever someone chose to move.

items.name: Diamond
items.found_note: — a square washer turned on its corner

ch6_l4.reward_title: Safe-isolation fittings and final gate record
ch6_l4.reward_text: Secure passage and confirm the physical diversion mechanism.
ch6_l4.subtitle: Protected route · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch6_l5.title: Public Forum
ch6_l5.intro: The benches fill quietly. Rusk looks first at the archive case, then at the empty space where he expected a single missing page.
ch6_l5.reward_text: Present the connected case using the conclusions from earlier chapters.
ch6_l5.subtitle: Public reckoning · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH

ch6_l6.title: Memory Room
ch6_l6.intro: The archive has opened a low room beside the public entrance. Anyone may read the corrected register here.

items.name: Crescent
items.found_note: — a moon on the keepsake tin

ch6_l6.reward_title: Corrected name entries and restoration pieces
ch6_l6.reward_text: Complete the register in a playable epilogue after the hearing.
ch6_l6.subtitle: Public reckoning · HIDDEN-OBJECT SEARCH
